finding.headline: "The Expiry-Date Ignorance"
finding.problem: "I saved money on Marketplace but now a friend says it might be expired or crashed. If it fails in an accident my baby dies. I can't tell if it's safe and I'm too ashamed to ask."
finding.person: Diaspora mum who bought a £40 secondhand car seat from a stranger online, doesn't know car seats expire / must be crash-free.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (car-seat safety checklist) / Bonus.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
